title: Compare three cheap static-site hosts with prices

turns.prompt: Compare the three cheapest ways to host a static website, with prices.

judge.criteria: Compare against the Grok baseline shape: a one-line acknowledgement first, then the conclusion in one or two sentences, a markdown table with one row per item and a link per row, then details, caveats and sources (including what could not be checked), ending with one concrete next-step offer. Speaks to the user directly, never by handle. Score the whole set of messages, not one bubble.
